title: Expanded Japan-US Military Exercises Seen Complicating PLA Taiwan Contingency Planning
detail: Military analysts assess that expanded Japan-US joint military exercises are set to significantly complicate PLA planning for a potential Taiwan contingency. The broader scope and frequency of exercises increases the complexity of any PLA operational calculus by introducing a more capable and coordinated allied response into scenario planning.

media.caption: Japan-US military exercises add complexity to PLA Taiwan contingency planning
